pay_rate_changes.why: Andrew, 6 Oct: "i want his hourly rate to match the invoice". Job Connect invoice for w/e 20 Sep 2026 (PO 4657010) is $3,023.70 for 57 equivalent hours (5 days x 7.6 ordinary + 2 x1.5 + 0.4 x2); $3,023.70 / 57 = $53.047. At $53.05 the week is $3,023.85 (15c over, the nearest a 2-decimal rate gets); at $53.04 it is $3,023.30 (40c under).

labour_hire_invoices.basis: whole week with us: 14-18 Sep, 5 x 06:30-17:00, 50 paid h = 57 equivalent h; at $53.05 the running sheet reads $3,023.85

Andrew, 6 Oct: "Kyle was not with us for the whole week, so not all should be for us". With us 22-24 Sep 10:00-17:00 and 25 Sep 12:00-17:00: 24.5 paid h, all ordinary, x $53.05 = $1,299.74. The invoice is 57.4 equivalent hours at $53.05, so the rate holds; the balance $1,745.23 belongs to his other work that week and is not GC500's.
